data.name: ClickFixIntro
data.value: You signed in with your passkey. Practise responding to an unexpected repair message. The exercise runs only in your browser: nothing is installed, copied or executed on your device.

data.name: ClickFixPrompt
data.value: Imagine a website claiming your device must be repaired before you can continue. It asks you to follow instructions outside the browser.

data.name: ClickFixFiction

data.name: ClickFixFollow
data.value: I would follow the repair message (simulate)

data.name: ClickFixStop
data.value: I stop and check through a trusted channel

data.name: ClickFixFollowResult
data.value: You chose to follow the message. Nothing was executed in this exercise. A real attacker hopes you trust an unsafe instruction because it looks like a solution.

data.name: ClickFixStopResult
data.value: You chose to stop and check the message. This interrupts the deception. Find a known contact yourself rather than using the contact details in the message.

data.name: ClickFixExplanation
data.value: This is called ClickFix: an attacker shows a problem or verification prompt and tricks you into taking the dangerous next step yourself. In a real attack this could start software, expose files or endanger an already signed-in session. This exercise does none of that.

data.name: ClickFixPasskeys
data.value: Your YubiKey protects you against phishing when you sign in. An infostealer can still steal your session cookie from your browser afterwards. An MDR solution can detect that suspicious behaviour on your device, allowing the security team to respond.

data.name: ClickFixLearn1
data.value: Stop at unexpected repair or verification requests.

data.name: ClickFixLearn2
data.value: Do not follow instructions outside the browser just because a website asks you to.

data.name: ClickFixLearn3
data.value: Check through a trusted channel and report the suspicious message.

data.name: ClickFixNoDetection
data.value: A reported choice is not proof of malware activity, session theft or MDR detection. Restarting the exercise does not change a recorded choice.

data.name: ClickFixNoScript
data.value: Enable JavaScript for the interactive exercise. No commands are executed.

data.name: ClickFixReview
data.value: Review what happened in this exercise.
